# **Technical Requirements \- Security Information & Event Management (SIEM)**

# **1\. Pendahuluan**

Dokumen ini menetapkan persyaratan teknis dan spesifikasi implementasi **Security Information & Event Management (SIEM)** menggunakan **Wazuh** dalam Proyek Manajemen Infrastruktur Pusat Data (DCIM).

Wazuh berfungsi sebagai platform SIEM/XDR terpusat yang bertanggung jawab untuk:

* Mengumpulkan dan menormalkan log keamanan  
* Melakukan korelasi dan deteksi ancaman secara real-time  
* Mendukung respons insiden keamanan  
* Memenuhi kebutuhan kepatuhan dan audit

Lingkup sistem mencakup seluruh komponen DCIM, infrastruktur pusat data, sistem operasi, dan perangkat keamanan.

# **2\. Kebutuhan Fungsional**

Komponen SIEM harus memenuhi fungsi inti berikut ini:

# **2.1. Log Ingestion and Normalization**

* **Requirement 2.1.1 (Log Source Support):** 

* Komponen DCIM (CMDB, Asset Repository, Analytics, Automation)  
* Sistem Operasi: Linux, Windows, macOS (melalui Wazuh Agent)  
* Perangkat jaringan: Firewall, Router, Switch (via Syslog)  
* Security tools: Antivirus, IDS/IPS, EDR  
* Aplikasi pihak ketiga (melalui file log atau API custom integration)

* **Requirement 2.1.2 (Protocol Support):** 

* Syslog (UDP, TCP, TLS)  
* Windows Event Log (agent-based)  
* File Integrity Monitoring (FIM)  
* REST API ingestion (custom integration)  
* Secure File Transfer (SFTP – via log forwarding)

* **Requirement 2.1.3 (Normalization):** 

* Decoder berbasis regex  
* Rule engine berbasis XML  
* Output event terstruktur dalam format JSON

# **2.2. Real-time Threat Detection and Correlation**

* **Requirement 2.2.1 (Rule Engine):** 

* Event correlation lintas host dan lintas sumber  
* Time-based correlation (frequency, timeframe)  
* Rule chaining (multi-stage attack detection)  
* Severity-based alerting  
    
* **Requirement 2.2.2 (Behavioral Analysis):** 

* Brute force detection  
* Privilege escalation  
* Login anomaly  
* Lateral movement indicators  
    
* **Requirement 2.2.3 (Threat Intelligence):** 

* MISP  
* AlienVault OTX  
* AbuseIPDB  
* VirusTotal

# **2.3. Security Incident and Response**

* **Requirement 2.3.1 (Alert Generation):** 

* Severity level (low hingga critical)  
* Konteks teknis lengkap (source, user, host, timestamp)  
* Notifikasi melalui dashboard, email, webhook, atau API

* **Requirement 2.3.2 (Case Management):** 

  Wazuh **tidak menyediakan case management native**, namun **harus** terintegrasi dengan sistem eksternal seperti:

* TheHive  
* Jira  
* ServiceNow

* **Requirement 2.3.3 (SOAR Integration):** 

* Active Response (block IP, disable user, kill process)  
* REST API integration (n8n)

# **3\. Kebutuhan Non-Fungsional**

# **3.1. Performance and Scalability**

* **Requirement 3.1.1 (EPS Capacity):** 

* Minimum 10.000 Events Per Second (EPS)  
* Skalabilitas hingga 20.000 EPS melalui horizontal scaling

* **Requirement 3.1.2 (Search Speed):** 

  Pencarian kompleks terhadap data log 30 hari **harus** memberikan hasil ≤ 5 detik, dengan dukungan:

* OpenSearch cluster  
* Hot / Warm / Cold index lifecycle

* **Requirement 3.1.3 (Scalability):** 

Wazuh mendukung horizontal scaling pada:

* Wazuh Manager cluster  
* OpenSearch Indexer  
* Log forwarder

# **3.2. Reliability and Availability**

* **Requirement 3.2.1 (HA):** 

Komponen berikut **harus** dikonfigurasi dalam mode HA:

* Wazuh Manager (cluster mode)  
* OpenSearch (multi-node cluster)  
* Dashboard (load balanced)

* **Requirement 3.2.2 (Data Integrity):** 

* TLS encryption in transit  
* Signed agent communication  
* File Integrity Monitoring (FIM)

# **3.3. Security and Compliance**

* **Requirement 3.3.1 (Access Control):** 

Wazuh **harus** menerapkan Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), dengan peran seperti:

* SOC Analyst  
* SOC Admin  
* Auditor

* **Requirement 3.3.2 (Data Retention):** 

Wazuh **harus** mendukung kebijakan retensi log:

* Hot storage: 90 hari  
* Warm/Cold/Archive storage: minimum 2 tahun

* **Requirement 3.3.3 (Internal Security):** 

* Menggunakan TLS end-to-end  
* Mengikuti hardening guide resmi  
* Mendapatkan patch keamanan berkala

# **4\. Spesifikasi Teknis**

# **4.1. Arsitektur**

Arsitektur SIEM berbasis Wazuh terdiri dari:

* Wazuh Agent pada endpoint dan server  
* Syslog collector untuk network devices  
* Wazuh Manager Cluster (correlation engine)  
* Wazuh Indexer Cluster (storage & analytics)  
* Wazuh Dashboard  
* Threat Intelligence Feeds  
* External SOAR & Case Management

Arsitektur ini bersifat terdistribusi, highly available, dan scalable.

# **4.2. Technology Stack**

| Category | Requirement | Preferred Technology/Platform | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Core SIEM Platform | High-speed ingestion and correlation | Wazuh | Must support DCIM-specific parsing. |
| Log Transport | Secure and reliable log forwarding | Wazuh Agent | Should support TLS encryption. |
| Data Storage | Optimized for time-series and search | Wazuh Indexer | Required for long-term retention and fast queries. |
| Deployment | Containerization and Orchestration | Docker/Kubernetes | For scalable and resilient deployment. |

# **4.3. Integration Requirements**

The SIEM component must integrate with the following DCIM and enterprise components:

| System/Service | Interface Type | Required Protocols | Data Flow Direction | Purpose |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| All DCIM Components | Log/API | Syslog, HTTPS API | Uni-directional (Read) | Ingesting application and system logs for security monitoring. |
| Workflow Automation (SOAR) | API | REST API (HTTPS) | Bi-directional (Read/Write) | Triggering automated response actions and updating incident status. |
| Configuration Management Database (CMDB) | API | REST API (HTTPS) | Uni-directional (Read) | Enriching security events with CI context (e.g., device criticality, owner). |
| IT Service Management (ITSM) | API | HTTPS/SOAP | Uni-directional (Write) | Automatic creation of security incident tickets. |
| Threat Intelligence Platform | API | HTTPS | Uni-directional (Read) | Importing IOCs for real-time detection. |

# **5\. Documentation and Training**

# **5.1. Documentation**

* **Requirement 5.1.1:**   
* Rule dan Use Case Wazuh  
* Panduan onboarding log source  
* Operational Runbook Wazuh  
* Dokumentasi custom decoder dan rule

# **5.2. Training**

Pelatihan **harus** mencakup:

* Pembuatan rule dan decoder Wazuh  
* Incident triage dan forensic search  
* Hands-on lab dan skenario serangan DCIM

# **6\. Penutup**

Dengan implementasi Wazuh, sistem SIEM pada lingkungan DCIM mampu memenuhi kebutuhan deteksi ancaman, korelasi log, kepatuhan, serta kesiapan respons insiden secara terpusat dan terukur.
